procedural_matters: ITA 9104 was represented by Andrea Bontempi (Helm)
GBR 8762 was represented by Cassius Day (Helm)
Witness, Edward Knowles crew of GBR 8643, gave evidence.
facts: In RS Feva XL World Championship race 11 the wind was approximately 12 knots with light waves.
GBR 8762 was approaching mark 3p on port tack, with ITA 9104 also on port tack, 10 m clear astern.
GBR 8762 rounded the mark with a lateral distance of one boat width to the mark.
conclusions: GBR 8762 did not touch the mark and complied with RRS 31.
